name: Alaska ComiCon
blurb: A comics and pop-culture convention at the Carlson Center in Fairbanks, with media guests, comic creators and local exhibitors.

picks: G.I. Joe, Dungeon Crawler Carl comics
Star Wars: Thrawn & Mara Jade novels

editions.evidence: Site title/header: 'Alaska ComiCon - Feb 20-21, 2027 in Fairbanks!' and homepage text 'Carlson Center 2010 2nd Ave, Fairbanks, AK'

notes: The 2027-exhibitors page cleanly separates 'MEDIA GUESTS:' (Dinniman, Hays, Cahill) and 'COMIC GUESTS:' (Shearer, Zahn, Parent) from 'COMIC RETAILERS', 'LOWER 48 EXHIBITORS', 'ALASKAN EXHIBITORS' and 'SPONSORS' sections, which were excluded as vendors/sponsors. Each guest's own bio page (linked from their photo) gave a one-line credit used verbatim for Known For (e.g. Jeff Hays: 'DCC Audio Book Narrator!'; Erin Cahill: 'Pink Ranger - Time Force!'; Timothy Zahn: 'Creator of Thrawn & Mara Jade! Star Wars!'; Dan Parent: 'Betty & Veronica! Archie Cover Artist!'; Brian Shearer: 'G.I. JOE! Dungeon Crawler Carl!'; Matt Dinniman: 'creator of the Dungeon Crawler Carl PHENOMENON'). No organizer/company name was visible on the site, so left blank rather than guessed. Cover falls back to the 2019 site logo (og:image); the only other images on the homepage are guest photos and sponsor logos, which the brief says to avoid using as the con's own cover. Verify pass (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh fetch of /2027-exhibitors/ shows the same 6 guest photos still filed as 'AKCC-2027-Square-*' and the sponsors block is headed '2027 ALASKA COMICON SPONSORS', so this is the 2027 lineup, not carried over.
